proposal.reason: Primary change is CE/DMA execution policy: reserving rings, remapping OKI QPs, and applying memcpy stream channel hints in init/enqueue/CE launch paths to separate CE memcpy from ltOki traffic and avoid mixed-operation hangs. Additional symmetric review is needed for independently substantive fixes in symmetric OKI device-kernel logic (AR/RS tail chunk sizing, pre-broadcast clamp, and lane-slice alignment) that change collective correctness behavior.
